div.div: غَضْنَهٌ [A patch of the smallpox] One says of a person whose skin has became covered, or wholly covered, (أُلْبِسَ,) with the smallpox, أُصْبَحَ جِلْدُهُ غَضْنَةً وَاحِدَةً [His skin has became (??) patch of the smallpox]: and some say غَضْبَة (S,)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
